system.description:
“Look at ‘em. Doesn’t he remind you of someone?”, the Bandit King asks his advisors as he stands, raising his hands in feigned confusion, in reference to the pale skinned boy tied to a chair and wounded from the interrogation techniques employed. “I think if you surrender now, you will have a chance at redemption mister.” The captured shinobi speaks, with a voice that would scream both ignorance and meekness. “Oh, really now boy? And what if I choose to not surrender? Whose gonna punish me ‘eh?” the Bandit King retorts with an obvious condemnation in his voice. “Ah well, at least we can’t be reprimanded for not giving them the option.” The boy responds speaking aloud. “What do you mean we!?” the Bandit responds, before the lights go out. A flash of light and the pale skinned boy with a sinister smile would be the last thing the Bandit King see’s before that same boy walks out of the Bandit camp, with his snake in tow and his team looking on in abject horror.

—Lyo Hataka

The Long Road, Ch. 9 excerpt.

Designed Existence

The Jinzo are named as such because they are a small pseudo family of people, not related by blood, but by design. Biologically designed individuals created either by a rogue scientist, or by sanctioned village action. Their current defining trait is that the members of this clan are a rough mix of decedents of both successful and failed artificial duplicates of the legendary Sanin, Jiraiya and Orochimaru, while others have been recently created and released or lost to the wild, with their own fates as their guide. While this is not an official family name or structured clan, most villages designate such individuals using Jinzo as their surname due to most of them not having an actual family name to refer to.

Jinzo Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Int, +1 Any, except Str or Int.

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Perception, Survival.

Extra Language: Bio-Speak, you understand Mutants and other artificially created beings that either have no language, or have developed their own makeshift language, being able to communicate with these creatures telepathically, while within 10 feet of them.

Passive Affinity: You begin with either Fire, Water or Lightning Release Affinity (Pick one).

Synthetic Techniques: The Jinzo Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Jinzo Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Branch Family: The Jinzo are split between two different branches, the [Shin Branch] and the [Bio Branch], also known amongst village elites as the Synthetic Human: Jiraiya or Orochimaru strains. The [Shin Branch] are members who were not born, but instead made. People who were given consciousness at their current stage in life, with no inherent memories beyond those they suddenly woke up with. The [Bio Branch] are members who were artificially born from a single strand of genetic data, with the inherent goal of evolving and surpassing the source of their DNA. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later.

Jinzo Features

Bio-Bonded Pet

1st Level Clan Feature

Every Jinzo carries within their biology, the capacity to generate a Bio-Bound Pet. A living extension of their own synthetic/artificial makeup. An entity grown of their own Biomass, bound to them on a biological level. At character creation, select either Bio-Snake or Bio-Toad, as your Bio-Pet. Your branch inherently leans towards one Bio-Pet, but you can choose either one. This choice cannot be changed later and helps define how you interact with both combat and exploration.

Your Bio-Pet is friendly to you and your allies, but only responds to your commands but can be no more than 120 feet away from you at any given time, being dismissed if you are ever outside of this range. In combat it acts as part of your turn, but has its own reaction. You can command your Bio-Pet in the following ways.

Move. At no action cost to you, you can command your Bio-Pet to move its full movement.

Strike. As part of an attack made with your Attack action or a Jutsu you cast that makes attacks, you can command your Bio-Pet to use either its Bite or Tongue Lash attack.

Synchronize. As a Bonus action, you can command your Bio-Pet to perform any of its special abilities, Dash, Disengage, Hide, Help or perform a skill-based action in place of you while exploring or not in combat.

When you are incapacitated or unconscious, your Bio-Pet cannot act on its own. If your Bio-Pet is reduced to 0 hit points, it immediately dies, and over the course of a Long Rest, you perform a secret ritual resummoning your Bio-Pet using your bio-mass as its base.

Your Bio-Pet is treated as the same level as you and gains special traits as it grows in level. When you would gain the Ability score increase/Feat class feature at levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 19, it also increases two of its ability modifiers and their associated saves by +1 of your choice up to a max of +5.

You must select your Bio-Pets type between the Bio-Amphibian and the Bio-Serpent. This also determines which Hijutsu you have access to.

Bio-Amphibian. A Bio-Pet designed for combination tactics and Combat synergy and aggression, linked to the [Shin Branch]

Bio-Serpent. A Bio-Pet designed for trickery, subterfuge, traps and tempo control, linked to the [Bio Branch]

Soft Physique

1st Level Clan Feature, [Bio Branch]

Your body isn’t bound by the same limitations as another human. Because you aren’t just human. You are more. The Genetic data woven into your biology grants you instinctive mastery over your own biomass and physical structure in the form of your Soft Physique Technique.

When initiative is rolled you can activate this technique for the duration of combat. Alternatively, you can activate this state as a Bonus action. While active you gain the following benefits:

Reach Extension. Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 property. This increases by +1 at 7th and 15th levels. This increased reach also extends to Taijutsu you cast, when you attempt the Grapple Skill action, or even when exploring the environment and attempting to grab, reach or interact with something within range that you can see.

Instinctual Coil. You can use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by the Hijutsu Flexibility clan trait when using the Grapple skill action.

Dragging Wrap. You can move your full movement speed while maintaining a Grapple. Also, you can push or pull a creature Grappled by you up to your full reach distance by spending 5 feet of your own movement, once per turn, without ending the grapple, as long as the creature remains within your reach at the end of the movement.

Coiling Pull. You can carry or grapple up to two creatures of your own size category or smaller, simultaneously, one in each arm.

Engineered Predator

1st Level Clan Feature, [Shin Branch]

You one day awoke the way you are. Conscious of yourself, your abilities and your potential, but not of your destiny. That you make yourself. This power is expressed through your skilled use of your Bio-Pet and special Fuinjutsu seals that amplify your technique. You gain the Shin-Pet and Shin-Seal abilities, but can only utilize one of these at a time.

When you enter initiative, you can begin to focus on either your Shin-Pet or Shin-Seal combat focus, which lasts until the end of combat. Alternatively, you can spend a Bonus action to enter one of these focuses outside of combat. You can switch your chosen focus as a Bonus action on your turn.

Shin-Pet

Your Bio-Pet isn’t designed just for combat, but also for penetration, getting into places and on targets without being detected. Your Bio-Pet gains the following abilities.

Extended Range. Your Bio-Pet can be up to 1 mile away from you without consequence. While further than 120 feet away from you, it cannot receive commands to Strike or Synchronize, but can follow the Move command.

Telepathic Link. Your Bio-Pet can communicate with you telepathically unless there is a chakra-based obstruction or barrier between you both. While telepathically communicating with you, your Bio-Pet conveys all that it can see and hear, within 60 feet of it.

Latch. Your Bio-Pet gains the Latch attack.

Latch. This attack can only be made while the pet is unseen or Hidden. Make a Melee Weapon Attack: 5ft., one target. Dex+ Prof to hit. On a hit, the bio-Pet becomes Latched. While latched, the Bio-Pet is attached to the target is moves with them automatically. You always know its exact location and attacks you make against a Latched creature ignores the benefits of cover or Invisibility, except full cover and cannot be made at disadvantage. A Latched creature can only detect the Bio-pet if they have Chakra Sensing or Chakra Sight or succeed on a perception check vs the Bio-Pets Stealth DC. If the Bio-Pet is detected, the Latched creature can spend a Bonus action to remove it, ending the Latched effect. If you switch Focus while your Bio-Pet is Latched they remain latched.

Shin-Seal

Your body naturally is attuned to a special Fuinjutsu signature that is unique to you or maybe your creator. A sign of your engineered origin. These seals are only visible to you, appearing as a pattern of your design.

You can apply a Shin-Seal to a creature when you successfully score a hit with an Attack you make, or as a Bonus action when you touch a structure or object.

You can mark a number of creatures, objects or structures equal to your proficiency bonus at a time and the Shin-Seal lasts for 1 minute or until spent by an effect that triggers them, such as Jinzo Hijutsu you cast. You always know which creatures or objects are currently marked by a Shin-Seal.

Creatures marked with your Shin-Seal remain marked even if you are not using this focus.,

Biological Evolution

3rd Level Clan Feature, [Bio Branch]

Your synthetic biology had hidden potential that is now being realized as you grow older and stronger. Things sealed away within your DNA that you can now access. Select 2 Biovolutions from the following list. You gain 1 additional Biovolution at 7th and 15th levels. Effects that force a saving throw or make an attack use your highest jutsu attack bonus or Save DC.

Constricting Coil

A creature Grappled by you, takes your [Unarmed Damage] at the start of each of their turns. This increases to twice your [Unarmed Damage] at 7th level and three times your [Unarmed Damage] at 15th level.

Alternatively, you can choose to forgo the damage of this Biovolution to instead force them to make a Strength saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened on a failure, as their body is compressed beyond their tolerance point. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th level and 3 ranks at 15th level.

Bio-Matter Strike

Your synthetic biology has unlocked a secondary gland that coats your extended limbs in a compound of your design when active. Once per turn, when you hit a creature and deal [Unarmed Damage] while Soft Physique is active, you can force them to make either a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, Pick one.

Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure, the affected creature gains 1 rank of Doused. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level

Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the affected creature gains the Stupor condition. At 11th level, if you score a critical hit with an unarmed attack, you instead inflict the Stupor condition without a saving throw.

Regenerative Tissue

Your cells have unlocked a rapid response healing protocol. Once per initiative, when you take damage that would reduce you below half your maximum it points, your body springs into action, rapidly regenerating 2d6 + Half your level in hit points at the end of the turn you took the damage.

Cellular Redistribution

Your body can redistribute impact across various points of your skeletal structure. When you take damage, you can spend your Reaction, to reduce the triggering damage by 2d8. You then immediately move up to 10 feet into a direction of your choice without provoking opportunity attacks as your body repurposes the kinetic energy. Beginning at 7th level, increase the damage reduction by 1d8, and an additional 1d8 at 15th level.

DNA Resonance

Your genetic makeup is malleable, and shift and reconstitute itself to aid another. As a Bonus action, by touching a willing creature within your reach, you channel biomass into them. The target creature removes 1 rank of any Physical or Sensory condition they have while also regaining 1d6 + your level in hit points. You can use this effect once per creature, per rest. Beginning at 7th level, you can also remove 1 rank of a Mental condition, and increase the hit points regained by +1d6. Beginning at 15th level, increase the number of times you can use this on a creature to twice per rest.

Biomass Augment

You learn to push your Biomass into your Bio-Pet temporarily expanding their physical capabilities beyond their base design. As a Bonus action, while your Bio-Pet is within 10 feet of you, you can both command and augment them until the end of your turn. While augmented your Bio-Pet gains the following:

Their size increases by 1 stage.

Their movement speed increases by +15 feet.

They gain a rank of Mastery to their attack rolls.

They increase the damage they deal with their Bite and Tongue Lash attacks by +1 damage die. This increases to +2 damage dies at 11th level.

Beginning at 7th level, this transformation lasts for up to 1 minute, but requires concentration as if concentrating on a B-Rank jutsu and they gain temporary hit points equal to your level for the duration. Beginning at 15th level, their size increases by 2 stages, and they gain DR equal to half your level.

Suppressive Grip

You can suppress chakra within a foe just by touching them. While a creature is Grappled by you, at the beginning of each of their turns, you can choose to make them make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 3d6 chakra damage, and gain 1 rank of Sealed for the duration of the grapple. The damage increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels. Beginning at 11th level, the ranks of Sealed increases to 2. A Grappled creature that has a ranks of Sealed due to this effect, loses the ranks of Sealed gained by this effect, when they are no longer Grappled by you.

Symbiotic Restorative

Your shared biology, allows your Bio-Pet to share in the benefits of restorative actions. When you would regain hit points, as a result of an item, jutsu or feature, if your Bio-Pet is within 10 feet of you, they regain half the hit points you gained as well.

Synthetic Awakening

3rd Level Clan Feature, [Shin Branch]

The knowledge stored within you synthetic body is not set in stone or static. It grows, branches and expresses itself as you accumulate more experience, represented as new things you begin to remember you can do. Select 2 Synthwakenings from the following list. You gain 1 additional Synthwakening at 7th and 15th levels. Effects that force a saving throw or make an attack use your highest jutsu attack bonus or Save DC.

Chakra Conduit

Your Bio-Pet develops Jutsu slots like a summoned creature, gaining its Constitution Modifier + half your level in slots, regaining spent slots when you complete a short or long rest and you gain the Cast command. When you gain this Synthwakening, they can select 2 D-Rank Jutsu with a nature release keyword that you have access to without the Fuinjutsu, Clone, or Kinjutsu keywords adding it to their jutsu list. Jutsu it casts uses its own ability modifiers, but your proficiency bonus to calculate their Attack bonuses and Save DCs.

Beginning at 7th level, they can select 2 C-Rank jutsu with the same restrictions. Beginning at 15th level, they can select 2 B-Rank jutsu with the same restrictions.

Cast. As a bonus action, you command your Bio-Pet to cast a jutsu it knows

Predatory Instincts

Your Bio-Pet has developed an aggressive response to threats against you. Your Bio-Pet gains the Multiattack and Camouflage abilities, both of which you can use as part of the Synchronize command.

Multiattack. This Bio-Pet can make two attacks using Tongue Lash, Oil Spit, or Bite.

Camouflage. This Bio-Pet becomes Invisible until it attacks, is touched, or 1 minute has passed. While invisible the Bio-Pet has a Rank of Mastery to its Latch attacks and increases its Stealth DC by +5. Beginning at 11th level, the Bio-Pet can maintain invisibility even after making a Latch attack.

Elemental Augmentations

Your synthetic physique carries with it special ways to infuse jutsu you cast. Once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu with the associated nature release keyword, you can use its listed effects. If the Jutsu cast has more than one nature release keyword, pick one of the listed effects.

Fire Release. If the Jutsu cast affects an area the shape of a Cube, sphere, cylinder or radius, increase the size of the affected area by +5 feet.

Water Release. If the jutsu cast doesn’t inflict an Elemental condition, you can force all affected creatures to make a Dexterity saving throw, gaining the Doused condition on a failure. If the jutsu cast does inflict a save, then on a failure they gain 1 rank of Doused. Beginning at 7th level, if the jutsu inflicts an Elemental condition, then it also inflicts 1 rank of Doused on a failure. Beginning at 11th level, increase the ranks of Doused inflicted by +1.

Lightning Release. If use the Jutsu’s Overcharge effect, it forces the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining Stupor on a failure. If the jutsu cast forces a saving throw, then if the target fails the original save, they gain the Stupor condition.

Synthetic Seal

Your Shin-Seals have developed a secondary property to them. While you have an active Shin-Seal, so long as it is within 60 feet of you, you can dispel that Shin-Seal as part of casting a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu that affects an area in the shape of a Sphere, Cube, radius or cylinder.

When you do, the jutsu becomes centered on the creature, structure or object that was marked with the Shin-Seal.

Layered Seal

Your Shin-Seals can now be stacked and layered onto creatures forming a more oppressive mark. A creature can now have up to 5 Shin-Seals on them at any given time. When a creature with Shin-Seals on them casts a Jutsu that you can see, you can spend your reaction to dispel all Shin-Seals on them. For every Shin-Seal dispelled this way, they increase the cost of the jutsu cast by +6.

Punishing Seal

Your Shin-Seals now interact with the Oil/Neurotoxin your Bio-Pet uses. When a creature with ranks of Doused or Stupor has a Shin-Seal, they suffer the listed effect based on the condition applied.

Doused. The affected creature cannot mold chakra appropriately without consequence. At the beginning of their turn when they maintain concentration on a Jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they increase the cost to maintain concentration by +6 for every rank of Doused they have.

Stupor. The affected creature has its nervous system under constant attack and stress. When they cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure their speed is reduced by half, and they must spend 5 feet of movement for every Attack they make until the end of the current turn. If they cannot spend the require movement, they cannot make the associated attack.

Installed Foresight

Your synthetic biology includes a predictive combat module that processes threat data faster than conscious thought. You cannot be Surprised, and once per turn, when a creature you can see makes an attack against you, you can spend your reaction to impose disadvantage on the triggering attack as your body moves before you even realize what is happening.

Beginning at 7th level, if the triggering attack misses, you can as part of the same Reaction cast a D-Rank Jinzo Hijutsu targeting the triggering creature at no chakra cost. This increases to C-Rank at 15th level

Latched Seal

Your Bio-Pet doesn’t just hold on, it also marks the latched creature so long as it is Latched.

Also, while a creature is both Latched by your Bio Pet, and marked with a Shin-Seal, the first time they would make a saving throw against a Jinzo clan Hijutsu you cast that affects an area, they cannot benefit from advantage or Jutsu based bonuses on this saving throw.

Synthetic Battle Aura

| #### Synthetic Chakra Mode / Battle Amp / Your chakra engine roars to life allowing you to emulate the power of Senjutsu. You have the following base benefits: / Synthetic Surge. You gain a +1 bonus to Unarmed Attacks, or Attacks made as a result of Jinzo Hijutsu. This increases to +2 at 15th level. / Accelerated Biology. Your movement speed increases by +20 feet, and you gain immunity to the Slowed condition and cannot have your speed reduced by hostile effects / Then you gain benefits based on which Branch you hail from; / Bio Branch / Unleashed Physique. Your Soft Physique feature is enhanced by providing an additional +1 rank of Reach. / Shedding Response. When you take damage that would reduce you to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction to end your Synthetic Chakra Mode and roll 6d6.Your hit points fall to 0 but you remain conscious, and at the end of the current turn, you regain the result of the roll dice as hit points. / Shin Branch / Overclock. You can benefit from both Shin-Pet and Shin-Seal at the same time, and once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, you can select one creature within 60 feet of you, marking them with a Shin-Seal. / Anchor Latch. While your Bio-Pet is Latched to a creature, that creature cannot teleport, lose their fly speed if any and cannot benefit from effects that would increase their movement speed. / Finally, you gain benefits based on which Bio-Pet you have beginning at 15th level. / Bio-Amphibian / Oil Field. Yor Bio-Amphibians oil glands go into overdrive. All hostile creatures that begins or ends their turn within 5 feet of the Bio-Pet, gains 1 rank of Doused. / Bio-Serpent / Chakra Serpent Projection. Your Bio-Serpent merges into your form, being manifested as a chakra construct connected to your lashing aura. It is always connected to you and can no longer be targeted for attacks or hostile effects. It can now only reach and affect creatures no more than 30 feet from you. It retains all of its abilities, and attacks. For the duration, you gain the Chakra Serpent Special Action. / Chakra Serpent. Once per turn, on your turn, you can spend this action to command your Bio-Serpent, in place of a Bonus action. |

7th Level Clan Feature

Your synthetic biology was never designed to replicate a human. You were always meant to both surpass your replicant, and become your own person. Deep within your engineer chakra network lies a dormant chakra engine that roars to life when you will it.

As a bonus action, you can activate your Synthetic Battle Aura for the next minute. When you do, your skin glows or has cybernetic patterns trace over it. Your hair glows or begins to grow in a wild pattern. Your eyes shift or begins to erupt in a pale like flame, and your begin to release enough chakra until it becomes visible to the naked eye. Once you use this state, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

Ghost Protocol

11th Level Clan Feature

Your Bio-Pet was not exclusively designed for combat. It was designed to help you surpass the original. It can go where you can’t, see what you cannot and hear what is out of reach. By spending 10 minutes in contact with your Bio-Pet, you can activate their Ghost Protocol for the next 24 hours. While active, your Bio-Pet can move at an accelerated rate, gaining +90 feet movement speed and can telepathically communicate with you. Also, while hidden they become Invisible, and is unable to be seen or sensed with Chakra sight or Chakra sensing, but in exchange they cannot receive the Strike, Synchronize or any commands gained as a result of either the Biological Evolution or Synthetic Awakening clan features.

The Bio-Pet becomes able to exist up to 10 miles away, sharing its vision and hearing with you and being able to still receive basic commands such as move and Latch (They can take the Latch command even if your Branch did not originally gain the Latch Command). The first time you would roll initiative in an area the Bio-Pet has explored using this feature within the next 24 hours, you roll at advantage. By spending 1 minute the Bio-Pet can draw a summoning seal, filling a 10-foot cube on the ground and then summon you and all willing creatures touching you to the summoning seal, filling spaces you each can occupy within 5 feet of the Bio-Pet with you being summoned in the Bio-Pets space. If there isn’t enough room to hold all creatures summoned this way, then you and randomly chosen creatures are summoned until no space within 5 feet of the Bio-Pet is available to be summoned in. Once you are summoned this way, the Bio-Pet cannot summon you again until you complete a Full Rest.

If the Bio-Pet is harmed in any way while this feature is active, this feature ends and that instance of the Bio-Pet dissolves. If the Bio-Pet is still Latched to a creature when the feature ends, if they are outside of its normal range it can persist away from you, it dispels itself before being resummoning itself within 10 feet of you.

I’ve Become, Me

15th Level Clan Feature

You are no longer a work in progress. An experiment or a mistake. You are yourself, no longer a copy of someone else. Your synthetic biology has developed the ability to analyze and integrate biological data from creatures you’ve come into contact with. Once per combat when your Bio-Pet deals damage to a non-construct hostile creature with its Bite or Tongue Lash attack, it steals some of the targets Bio-data. Select one of the following benefits, which you maintain until the end of combat.

Adaptive Resilience. You gain a random resistance the target creature has.

Adaptive Senses. You gain a random special sense such as Tremor sense, Blindsight, Darkvision or Chakra sight.

Adaptive Physiology. You gain one random saving throw proficiency from the target creature that you don’t have proficiency in.

| Doused / Max Ranks: 5, [Elemental], [Physical] / A Doused creature is covered in a toads belly oil, usually very flammable…oh no. / A Doused creature that takes Fire or Lightning damage takes 1d6 fire damage for each rank of Doused they have. Remove all ranks of Doused after this conditional damage is applied. / A Doused creature that takes Cold damage has its speed reduced by 10 feet for each rank of Doused they have and they cannot gain a bonus to speed, until the end of their next turn. Remove all ranks of Doused when this effect is applied. / A Doused creature can spend an Action, to make a DC 15 Dexterity ability check to end this affliction or submerge themselves fully into a body of water. |

Bio-Serpent

Small, Mutant

Armor Class 10 + Dexterity Mod + your proficiency bonus

Hit Points 10 + (6 times half level)

Speed 30 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +3 | + | CON | +2 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +3 | + | INT | +2 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Save Proficiencies Dexterity, Constitution, Charisma (Add your Prof bonus with the listed Mod to calculate their Save Bonus. All others, only add half your prof bonus.)

Skills Athletics, Stealth, Perception

Senses Darkvision (60ft), Keen Smell

Bio-Serpent Traits

Slithering Ambush. Once per turn, when a hostile creature makes an attack against the Bio-Serpents summoner, the Bio-Serpent can make a Bite attack, at no action cost, against the attacking creature.

Battle Fatigue. The Bio Serpent has abilities that have charges. They regain these charges when a new initiative is rolled.

Attacks

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: 5ft., one target. Dex+ Prof to hit, 1d6+Dexterity Mod Piercing damage. On a hit, the target must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining the Stupor condition.

Constrict. The Bio-Serpent grows in length and size, before wrapping itself around a creature it can see within 5 feet of it, restricting its movements. The target creature must make a Strength saving throw, being Grappled. Grappled creature can spend its action to attempt to escape as normal.

Shed Skin (7th level, 2/Charges). When the Bio-Serpent takes damage, it can shed its outer layer of skin as a reaction, reducing the triggering damage by half as its discarded scales take the brunt of the impact.

Serpent Coil (15th level, 1/Charges). When the Bio-Serpent Successfully grapples a creature, it can make 3 Bite attacks against them. If two of the three attacks are successful, the target creature is Stunned until the end of the current turn.

Bio-Amphibian

Small, Mutant

Armor Class 10 + Dexterity Mod + your proficiency bonus

Hit Points 10 + (8 times half level)

Speed 30 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +2 | + | CON | +3 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +2 | + | INT | +3 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Save Proficiencies Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom (Add your Prof bonus with the listed Mod to calculate their Save Bonus. All others, only add half your prof bonus.)

Skills Acrobatics, Stealth, Perception

Senses Amphibian, Keen Sight

Bio-Amphibian Traits

Spy. The Bio Amphibian is a master at stealth and infiltration. It gains a rank of Mastery at Stealth. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Battle Fatigue. The Bio Amphibian has abilities that have charges. They regain these charges when a new initiative is rolled.

Attacks

Tongue Lash. Melee Weapon Attack: 15ft., one target. Str+ Prof to hit, 1d6+Strength Mod bludgeoning damage and the target is moved 5-feet along the ground, into a space that can hold it.

Oil Spit. Ranged Attack: 30 feet, one target. Dex (or Int) + to hit. The target gains 1 rank of Doused being coated in toad oil. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

Sticky Ground (7th level, 2/Charges). The Bio-Amphibian secretes oil from its body, across the ground filling a 10-foot radius around itself. The area becomes difficult terrain and if a jutsu that can trigger the Doused condition affects the area or a creature within the area, all creatures within the area, suffer the effects of the Doused condition.

Oil Burst (15th level, 1/Charges). When the Bio-Amphibian takes damage, it can spend its reaction to detonate its oil reserves, even if that damage reduced it to 0 hit points. All creatures within 15 feet of the Bio-Amphibian must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 fire damage, and gaining the maximum ranks of Doused. On a success they take half damage and no further effects.
